title: Meet Scout the Fox and How We Choose Family Days Out
description: Meet Scout the Fox, the HappyDaysOut mascot, and find out how we research days out, check offers on official sites and keep our advice honest and independent.
intro: Scout is our curious, bargain-sniffing guide to family days out. Here’s who Scout is, how we research every page, and how we keep our tips honest.

image.alt: A family walking together on a grassy hill

blocks.html:
Hello, I’m Scout!

I’m a fox with a green explorer hat, a blue scarf and a nose for a good deal. I love castles, coasters, rock pools and anything with a picnic. On every HappyDaysOut page you’ll find my tips: who a day out suits, how to pay less, and what to watch out for.

I’m a cartoon mascot, so my tips are written by the HappyDaysOut editorial team, using official sources.

sections.html:
• We check ticket rules, ages, opening and offers on official websites: the attraction itself, or the organisation behind a scheme.
  • Offers show the date we last checked them. Prices and offers change, so always confirm before you pay.
  • Posts link to their sources so you can check them too.

sections.h2: What Scout’s verdicts are, and aren’t
sections.html: Scout’s verdicts are editorial guidance: who a day out suits, the best ways to save and common things to watch out for. They are not paid reviews, and we never publish made-up star ratings, invented visitor reviews or fake discount codes.
HappyDaysOut is free. Some links may be affiliate links, so we may earn a commission if you book, at no extra cost to you. This never changes what we recommend. Read how Shmor.ai makes money.
HappyDaysOut is part of Shmor.ai, a network of free comparison sites for the US, UK and Europe, including TravelDeals for holidays and CruiseDeals for cruises.
